what_works: Grid-aligned monospace labels sit alongside neutral sans body — every section reads like a spec sheet. The 'system / numbered / metadata' feel translates to 'we measure everything' for a technical trade.
what_does_not_translate: Pure monochrome minimalism can feel cold for a service business — add one warm accent (warm-grey or muted blue) so it reads competent, not clinical.
type_observations: Monospace (JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono style) for labels and metadata; neutral grotesk for paragraphs — type pairing carries the 'tech-credible' signal.
